g.text: AXI write deadlock: before and after the fix
Measured VCD traces | same 4-byte copy, same AW_MODE=0 slave, only the engine RTL changes
AWVALID waits for AWREADY; WVALID never rises.
The same stalled levels persist through the 1060 ns watchdog.
W is accepted at 85 ns, AW at 125 ns.
Each VALID retires independently; DONE rises at 145 ns.
Handshakes are sampled on rising clock edges using pre-edge VALID/READY. Both panels use the same time scale.
